summary: A Form 6-K filed by GRAVITY Co., Ltd. announces the closing of its shareholder register and record date for an interim dividend. The register will close from July 1 to July 10, 2026, with a record date of June 30, 2026, for determining shareholders eligible for the interim dividend for fiscal year 2026. The dividend amount is to be determined by the board. No terms, consideration, premium, or advisory details are provided. This is a routine corporate housekeeping filing, not a special situation, with no deal mechanics, overhang, or risk-arb angle.
